summary: Verified the contact-orbit animation fix on the home page. The .contact-orbit element itself has transform: none (text 'LET'S BUILD / SOMETHING / TOGETHER' is upright and readable). The ::before ring has animation 'orbit-spin 26s' and the ::after ring rotates in reverse; sampled computed transforms 1.5s apart with no scroll/input on both pseudo-elements and both changed, confirming continuous smooth rotation independent of scroll. No console errors or pageerrors. All home page sections (hero-section, network-section with 6 panels ending in FURNITURE, experience-spotlight, purpose-section, work-slideshow, clients-section, contact-section) render correctly. Regression: /stays/premium loads (title 'Premium Stays | BDSM · BDS Marvel') without errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Contact orbit is pure-CSS animated (@keyframes orbit-spin) now; verify by sampling getComputedStyle(el, '::before').transform at two timestamps without scrolling. Preloader curtain runs ~2.3s on first visit — use sessionStorage 'bdsm-visited'='1' or wait ~3s.
rca of the issue: Fix confirmed working: removal of scroll-linked CSS vars/useOrbitScroll and adoption of pure CSS keyframes on ::before (26s) and ::after (19s reverse) yields continuous smooth rotation with upright text.
